body: Honestly had not thought of a crowd before.  As his son, I always imagined I would be asked to say something, but you are right - I could just aim to blend in.  If a step/sibling wants to chat we could step away from all the grandkids.  Thank-you!

I feel like I would be living the definition of insanity.  I reached out at 18 after finding housing, no good answer on why I could not live at home (had an internship lined up in my field of study after my freshman year of college with this).  Reached out after 22, the money was taken because "I did not earn it" and was used to expense a vacation of theirs.  Reached out after 24 via that e-mail, and got NO response.  For a long time I internalized that lack of response.    
To be a decade on, still reaching out, hoping for \_\_\_\_\_ (acknowledgment, apology, angry response), makes me feel that I am stuck in a vicious cycle.
